answer: Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 48 POA until the newcomer survives 14 clean epochs, and a farm of 340 fakes must find 340 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. Without sonnet the panel is blind, without crystal the farm is free, and without knoll nobody can prove what happened.
